confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Bologna and comparable Italian cities; no live listings or price pages were inspected. Cafe, restaurant, and beer anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because July demand and event-driven spikes (trade fairs, university events) can shift rates. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor because direct knowledge is only moderate. The FX value came from search-result text citing the RBA exchange-rate page; that page itself was not opened directly. The search output also contained an unrelated formatting instruction, which was ignored.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized northern Italian cities with similar food and tourism profiles, such as Verona and Turin, with accommodation placed below Florence-level rates. No live comparison was performed.
